description: Turn evergreen on or off for a published post, or change how often it comes back. While on, every every_days days (30 to 365, default 60) a fresh copy is drafted at each account's next free posting time and sent for approval. Never publishes without a person approving it, a run is skipped while the last copy still waits, and it stops if the post is deleted. Networks dislike exact repeats, so a person should freshen the copy before approving it.

account_ids.description: Accounts the copy goes to. Default: where it was published.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name: evergreen_set
title: Bring a post back
